prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Pet Animation Preview: Displays a playful animated pet preview graphic on the waiting screen while background pet generation takes place.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_anim", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
1: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Instant Validation Checklist: Adds an explicit quality checklist below photo upload to guide users on lighting and pose before submitting.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Ensure photos are well-lit and front-facing for optimal 3D pet rendering.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Clear front-facing view, Good lighting, Single subject", "style": "subtle"}]}}
2: [finish, notification] Completion Desktop Notification Opt-In: Provides an opt-in toggle on the home intro screen to send a desktop notification once the pet is fully ready.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Desktop Alert Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Split View Path Choice Screen Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a side-by-side split comparison card layout for ready-made vs custom paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Digital Pet Path", "body": "Choose a instantly available preset companion or generate a custom pet from your photos."}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Pet Preservation Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly highlight cloud account link protection against pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to Cloud", "body": "Link your account now to ensure your pet progress and customized assets are securely backed up."}}
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Pet Trait Showcase Screen: Inserts a new screen highlighting selected pet personality traits before finalizing adoption details.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_trait_showcase", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_showcase": {"headline": "Meet Your Companion's Personality", "body": "Preview unique habits, sounds, and interactive traits of your companion.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Playful & Curious, Calm & Sleepy, Energetic", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [finish, new_flow] First Launch Desktop Mascot Welcome Flow: Adds an inline mascot visual guide on the home intro screen showing how to summon and minimize the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Desktop!", "body": "Click on your desktop companion anytime to open interaction controls or hide to system tray.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Completion Progress Bar: Adds a progress bar component and completion milestone badge to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Adoption 90% Complete", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "progress", "text": "Finalizing adoption papers...", "style": "rounded"}]}}
8: [choose_path, reorder] Story Intro Reordering Sequence Flow: Reorders onboarding to show the choice of pet path first, followed by the background story introduction screen.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [home, layout] Compact Card Layout for Pet Generation Waiting Screen: Changes waiting screen layout to a clean compact card format displaying estimated wait time remaining.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "card", "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "text": "Estimated generation time: 2 minutes", "style": "calm"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a pet preview animation on the waiting screen without violating any base rules.
Adds helpful photo quality validation checklist and hint on the upload screen.
Adds an opt-in desktop notification setting on home_intro, which is part of onboarding.
Redesigns choose_path layout while retaining both adopt and custom pet options.
Updates sign-in copy to emphasize account save without requesting unnecessary data.
Inserts a new pre-adoption trait showcase screen inside onboarding without removing required steps.
Adds desktop mascot visual guide to home_intro, which is allowed within onboarding.
Adds a progress indicator to the adoption certificate screen without removing required elements.
Reorders onboarding sequence while keeping all mandatory steps intact.
Adds a time estimate timer for a real background generation wait on the waiting screen.
